message.reasoning_content:
The error shows that the CONST...END_CONST block with named constants is not supported. I need to use literal values directly or use a different approach. In IEC 61131-3 ST, you can use VAR_CONSTANT for constants, but the syntax I'm using may not be compatible with all compilers.

Let me rewrite using direct integer literals instead of named constants, which is more portable and will work with most IEC 61131-3 compilers.
